changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CompanySetting') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[CompanySetting]( [CompanyID] [int] NOT NULL, [ID] [int] NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](max) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Setting] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [CompanyID] ASC, [ID] ASC ) ) END
